run_training_curl: run the CURL training script on MNIST or Omniglot datasets with configurable hyperparameters
get_data_sources: create dataset iterators for training validation and test splits from a TensorFlow dataset
setup_training_and_eval_graphs: build TensorFlow graph ops for ELBO loss confusion matrix and purity metrics
process_dataset: process a dataset by computing TensorFlow ops batch by batch and aggregating results
setup_dynamic_ops: set up TensorFlow ops to dynamically copy mixture component weights for expansion
